where.en: From the base of the skull to the top of the shoulder
Side of the neck down to the top corner of the shoulder blade
where.zh: 由頸側去到肩胛骨上角

where.en: Front and side of the neck, down to the first ribs
where.zh: 頸嘅前側同側面，連去最上面嘅肋骨

where.en: Front of the shoulder cap
Back of the shoulder cap
Small muscles around the shoulder blade that steady the shoulder joint
where.zh: 包住肩胛骨、穩定肩關節嘅一組細肌肉

where.en: The large chest muscle, from breastbone to upper arm
where.zh: 胸口嘅大肌肉，由胸骨連去上臂

where.en: Front of the upper arm
Back of the upper arm
Palm side of the forearm
The wide muscle from the mid and lower back up to the armpit
where.zh: 由中下背伸展到腋下嘅大片肌肉

where.en: Between the spine and the shoulder blades
Front of the abdomen, from ribs to pelvis
where.zh: 肚嘅正前面，由肋骨去到盆骨

where.en: Sides of the waist
Two columns of muscle running along the spine
where.zh: 沿住脊骨兩邊嘅兩條長肌肉

where.en: Deep in the lower back, between the lowest rib and the pelvis
where.zh: 腰嘅深層，最低肋骨同盆骨之間

where.en: Deep in the front of the hip, from the lower spine to the thigh bone
where.zh: 髖部前面深層，由腰椎連去大腿骨

where.en: Outer front of the hip, continuing down the outside of the thigh
where.zh: 髖部外前側，沿大腿外側落去

where.en: The main muscle of the buttock
Upper outer part of the buttock
Deep in the buttock, from the tailbone area to the hip
where.zh: 臀部深層，由尾龍骨附近連去髖關節

where.en: Front of the thigh
Inner thigh
Back of the thigh
Upper calf, the visible bulge
Lower, deeper calf, down to the Achilles tendon
where.zh: 小腿下半部深層，連去腳跟筋

summary.en: Gently tilt your ear toward your shoulder.
summary.zh: 慢慢將耳仔向膊頭方向側。

steps.en: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and down.
steps.zh: 坐直或企直，膊頭放鬆向下沉。

steps.en: Slowly tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder.
steps.zh: 慢慢將右耳向右膊頭側落去。

steps.en: For a deeper stretch, rest your right hand lightly on the left side of your head.
steps.zh: 想拉深啲，可以將右手輕輕放喺頭嘅左邊。

steps.en: Hold, breathing slowly, then return to centre and switch sides.
steps.zh: 保持姿勢、慢慢呼吸，然後返回中間再換另一邊。

safety.en: Do not pull hard on your head – the weight of your hand is enough.
safety.zh: 唔好大力拉個頭——隻手嘅重量已經夠。

safety.en: Keep the opposite shoulder down; don't shrug.
safety.zh: 另一邊膊頭保持向下，唔好聳膊。

safety.en: Stop if you feel tingling or numbness down your arm.
safety.zh: 如果手臂有麻痺或者刺痛感，即刻停止。

summary.en: Turn your nose toward your armpit to stretch the back of the neck.
summary.zh: 將鼻尖轉向腋下，伸展頸後。

steps.en: Sit tall and turn your head about 45° to the right.
steps.zh: 坐直，將頭轉向右邊大約 45°。

steps.en: Drop your chin, as if looking toward your right armpit.
steps.zh: 收下巴，好似望向右邊腋下咁。

steps.en: Place your right hand on the back of your head and let its weight add a gentle stretch.
steps.zh: 將右手放喺後腦，用手嘅重量輕輕加深伸展。

steps.en: Hold, then slowly lift your head and repeat on the other side.
steps.zh: 保持，然後慢慢抬返起個頭，換另一邊重複。

safety.en: Move slowly into and out of the stretch.
safety.zh: 入同出呢個姿勢都要慢。

safety.en: Keep the stretch mild – you should feel it along the back and side of the neck, not sharp pain.
safety.zh: 伸展感要溫和——應該係頸後同側面有拉緊感，唔係刺痛。

summary.en: Partner steadies your shoulder while you tilt your head away.
summary.zh: 拍檔穩住你膊頭，你將頭側向另一邊。

steps.en: Sit on a chair; your partner stands behind you.
steps.zh: 坐喺櫈上，拍檔企喺你後面。

steps.en: Your partner rests one hand lightly on top of your left shoulder to keep it down.
steps.zh: 拍檔將一隻手輕輕放喺你左膊頭上面，令佢保持向下。

steps.en: Slowly tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder yourself – your partner does not push your head.
steps.zh: 你自己慢慢將右耳側向右膊頭——拍檔唔會推你個頭。

steps.en: Hold, then come back to centre and switch sides.
steps.zh: 保持，然後返回中間，換另一邊。

safety.en: The partner only stabilises the shoulder – never press on the head or neck.
safety.zh: 拍檔只係穩住膊頭——絕對唔好按個頭或者條頸。

safety.en: Agree on a clear 'stop' word before starting.
safety.zh: 開始之前講好一個清楚嘅「停」字。

safety.en: Not recommended if you have a recent neck injury.
safety.zh: 如果頸部最近受過傷，唔建議做。

summary.en: Draw one arm across your chest to stretch the back of the shoulder.
summary.zh: 將一隻手橫過胸前，伸展膊頭後面。

steps.en: Stand or sit tall.
steps.zh: 企直或坐直。

steps.en: Bring your right arm straight across your chest at shoulder height.
steps.zh: 將右手伸直，喺膊頭高度橫過胸前。

steps.en: Use your left forearm above (not on) the elbow to draw the arm closer to your body.
steps.zh: 用左前臂喺手踭上面（唔好壓住手踭）將手臂拉近身體。

steps.en: Hold, then switch arms.
steps.zh: 保持，然後換手。

safety.en: Keep your shoulder down, away from your ear.
safety.zh: 膊頭保持向下，唔好貼近耳仔。

safety.en: Avoid pressing directly on the elbow joint.
safety.zh: 避免直接壓住手踭關節。

summary.en: Open the front of the shoulder and chest against a wall.
summary.zh: 靠住牆打開膊頭前面同胸口。

steps.en: Stand side-on to a wall and place your right palm on it at shoulder height, arm straight behind you.
steps.zh: 側身企喺牆邊，右手掌喺膊頭高度按住牆，手臂伸直喺身後。

steps.en: Slowly turn your feet and body away from the wall until you feel a stretch across the chest and front of the shoulder.
steps.zh: 慢慢將腳同身體轉離牆，直到胸口同膊頭前面有拉緊感。

steps.en: Keep your chest lifted and breathe.
steps.zh: 胸口保持挺起，正常呼吸。

steps.en: Hold, then turn back and switch sides.
steps.zh: 保持，然後轉返嚟，換另一邊。

safety.en: Rotate gently – don't force the shoulder backwards.
safety.zh: 轉身要慢——唔好用力將膊頭向後扯。

safety.en: Lower your hand if you feel pinching at the front of the shoulder.
safety.zh: 如果膊頭前面有夾住嘅感覺，將手放低啲。

summary.en: Partner gently draws your arms back to open the chest.
summary.zh: 拍檔輕輕將你手臂向後拉，打開胸口。

steps.en: Sit tall on the floor or a stool with your hands clasped behind your head.
steps.zh: 坐直喺地下或者凳上，雙手交叉放喺後腦。

steps.en: Your partner stands behind you and holds your elbows.
steps.zh: 拍檔企喺你後面，揸住你兩個手踭。

steps.en: Your partner slowly draws your elbows backward until you feel a stretch across the chest.
steps.zh: 拍檔慢慢將你兩個手踭向後拉，直到胸口有拉緊感。

steps.en: Hold, breathing slowly, then your partner releases gradually.
steps.zh: 保持、慢慢呼吸，然後拍檔逐少逐少放手。

safety.en: Partner moves slowly and stops the moment you say so.
safety.zh: 拍檔動作要慢，你一講停就要即刻停。

safety.en: Don't let your head be pushed forward – keep your neck neutral.
safety.zh: 唔好俾個頭被推向前——條頸保持自然位置。

safety.en: Avoid if you have a history of shoulder dislocation.
safety.zh: 如果膊頭曾經甩骹，避免做呢個動作。

summary.en: Hold a towel behind your back to stretch shoulders and triceps.
summary.zh: 喺背後揸住毛巾，伸展膊頭同手臂後側。

steps.en: Hold one end of a towel in your right hand and lift it overhead, letting the towel hang down your back.
steps.zh: 右手揸住毛巾一頭，舉過頭，等毛巾垂落背後。

steps.en: Reach behind your lower back with your left hand and grab the other end.
steps.zh: 左手喺腰後面揸住毛巾另一頭。

steps.en: Gently pull down with the left hand to stretch the right shoulder and triceps.
steps.zh: 左手輕輕向下拉，伸展右膊頭同手臂後側（三頭肌）。

steps.en: Then pull up with the right hand to stretch the left shoulder. Hold, then swap hands.
steps.zh: 再用右手向上拉，伸展左膊頭。保持，然後兩隻手調換。

safety.en: Walk your hands closer together only as far as is comfortable.
safety.zh: 兩隻手只係拉近到舒服嘅位置就夠。

safety.en: Keep your back from arching – brace your stomach lightly.
safety.zh: 腰唔好拱起——輕輕收緊個肚。

summary.en: Flow between rounding and arching your spine on hands and knees.
summary.zh: 四點跪姿，喺拱背同塌腰之間慢慢郁動。

steps.en: Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
steps.zh: 四點跪喺地上，手喺膊頭正下面，膝頭喺髖部正下面。

steps.en: Breathe in: let your belly lower and lift your chest and tailbone (cow).
steps.zh: 吸氣：個肚向下沉，胸口同尾龍骨向上提（牛式）。

steps.en: Breathe out: round your back toward the ceiling and tuck your chin (cat).
steps.zh: 呼氣：背向天花板拱起，收下巴（貓式）。

steps.en: Move slowly between the two positions for the full time.
steps.zh: 喺兩個姿勢之間慢慢郁，做足成段時間。

safety.en: Move only within a pain-free range.
safety.zh: 只喺唔痛嘅範圍內郁動。

safety.en: Place a folded towel under your knees if they're sensitive.
safety.zh: 膝頭敏感嘅話，可以墊一條摺好嘅毛巾。

summary.en: Sit back onto your heels and reach forward to lengthen the back.
summary.zh: 坐返落腳跟，雙手向前伸，拉長背部。

steps.en: Kneel on the floor with your big toes together and knees apart.
steps.zh: 跪喺地上，兩隻大腳趾貼埋，膝頭打開。

steps.en: Sit your hips back toward your heels.
steps.zh: 將臀部向後坐向腳跟。

steps.en: Walk your hands forward and lower your chest toward the floor.
steps.zh: 雙手向前爬，胸口慢慢落向地面。

steps.en: Rest your forehead down and breathe into your back.
steps.zh: 額頭貼地，深呼吸，感受背部放鬆。

safety.en: Put a cushion between your heels and hips if your knees are tight.
safety.zh: 如果膝頭緊，可以喺腳跟同臀部之間放個咕臣。

safety.en: Skip this if you have a knee injury.
safety.zh: 膝頭有傷就唔好做。

summary.en: Hold hands and lean back away from each other to stretch the upper back.
summary.zh: 互相拉住手向後坐，伸展上背。

steps.en: Stand facing your partner, about an arm's length apart, feet hip-width.
steps.zh: 同拍檔面對面企，相距大約一隻手臂，雙腳與髖同寬。

steps.en: Hold each other's wrists firmly.
steps.zh: 互相緊握對方手腕。

steps.en: Both bend your knees slightly and sit your hips back at the same time, rounding your upper backs.
steps.zh: 兩個人同時微微屈膝、臀部向後坐，上背拱起。

steps.en: Hold, then both stand up slowly together.
steps.zh: 保持，然後兩個人一齊慢慢企返起身。

safety.en: Use a firm wrist grip so nobody slips.
safety.zh: 要揸實手腕，避免有人甩手。

safety.en: Lean back at the same pace and come up together – never let go suddenly.
safety.zh: 兩個人用同一個速度向後挨，一齊起身——千祈唔好突然放手。

safety.en: Choose a partner of a similar weight.
safety.zh: 揀一個體重差唔多嘅拍檔。

summary.en: Lean back over a foam roller to open the upper back.
summary.zh: 向後挨喺按摩滾筒上，打開上背。

steps.en: Sit on the floor with a foam roller behind you, across your upper back just below the shoulder blades.
steps.zh: 坐喺地上，將按摩滾筒橫放喺上背、膊頭骨下面少少。

steps.en: Support your head with your hands, elbows pointing forward.
steps.zh: 雙手托住個頭，手踭向前。

steps.en: Keep your hips on the floor and gently lean back over the roller.
steps.zh: 臀部保持貼地，慢慢向後挨過滾筒。

steps.en: Hold, breathing out as you relax. Move the roller up a few centimetres and repeat if you like.
steps.zh: 保持，呼氣時放鬆。想嘅話將滾筒向上移幾厘米再做一次。

safety.en: Keep the roller on your upper and middle back – never under your lower back or neck.
safety.zh: 滾筒只放喺上背同中背——絕對唔好放喺腰或者頸下面。

safety.en: Support your head the whole time.
safety.zh: 全程用手托住個頭。

summary.en: Hug one knee in while lying on your back.
summary.zh: 瞓喺地上，將一邊膝頭抱向胸口。

steps.en: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat.
steps.zh: 仰臥，兩邊膝頭屈曲，腳掌貼地。

steps.en: Bring your right knee toward your chest, holding behind the thigh or on the shin.
steps.zh: 將右膝拉向胸口，雙手揸住大腿後面或者小腿。

steps.en: Keep your lower back relaxed against the floor.
steps.zh: 腰部放鬆貼地。

steps.en: Hold, then lower and switch legs. You can also hug both knees together.
steps.zh: 保持，然後放低，換腳。你亦可以兩邊膝頭一齊抱。

safety.en: Hold behind the thigh if you have knee problems.
safety.zh: 膝頭有問題嘅話，揸大腿後面。

safety.en: Keep your head resting on the floor.
safety.zh: 個頭保持瞓喺地上。

summary.en: Let your knees drop to one side while your shoulders stay down.
summary.zh: 膝頭倒向一邊，膊頭保持貼地。

steps.en: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, arms out wide in a T.
steps.zh: 仰臥，膝頭屈曲、腳掌貼地，雙手向兩邊打開成 T 字。

steps.en: Keeping your knees together, slowly lower them to the right.
steps.zh: 兩邊膝頭貼埋，慢慢倒向右邊。

steps.en: Turn your head to the left if it's comfortable.
steps.zh: 舒服嘅話，將頭轉向左邊。

steps.en: Hold, then bring your knees back to centre and lower them to the other side.
steps.zh: 保持，然後將膝頭返回中間，再倒向另一邊。

safety.en: Keep both shoulders on the floor.
safety.zh: 兩邊膊頭都要貼地。

safety.en: Place a pillow under your knees if they don't reach the floor.
safety.zh: 膝頭掂唔到地嘅話，喺膝頭下面墊個枕頭。

safety.en: Twist gently – avoid if twisting aggravates back pain.
safety.zh: 扭轉要溫和——如果扭轉會令腰痛加劇就唔好做。

summary.en: Partner gently supports both knees toward your chest.
summary.zh: 拍檔輕輕幫你將兩邊膝頭推向胸口。

steps.en: Lie on your back and draw both knees toward your chest.
steps.zh: 仰臥，將兩邊膝頭拉向胸口。

steps.en: Your partner kneels at your feet and places their hands on your shins.
steps.zh: 拍檔跪喺你腳邊，雙手放喺你小腿上。

steps.en: Your partner leans in gently to bring your knees slightly closer, only as far as you guide them.
steps.zh: 拍檔輕輕向前挨，將你膝頭推近少少，只推到你指示嘅位置。

steps.en: Hold, then your partner slowly releases.
steps.zh: 保持，然後拍檔慢慢放鬆。

safety.en: The partner applies very light pressure – this should never hurt.
safety.zh: 拍檔只可以用好輕嘅力——呢個動作唔應該有痛。

safety.en: Keep your tailbone on or near the floor.
safety.zh: 尾龍骨保持喺地上或者貼近地面。

safety.en: Not suitable if you have a disc injury unless your physio approves it.
safety.zh: 如果有椎間盤問題，除非物理治療師批准，否則唔適合做。

summary.en: Lie face-down over an exercise ball to round and relax the back.
summary.zh: 伏喺健身球上，令背部拱起放鬆。

steps.en: Kneel in front of an exercise ball.
steps.zh: 跪喺健身球前面。

steps.en: Lie your stomach and chest over the ball, letting your back round.
steps.zh: 將個肚同胸口伏喺球上，等背部自然拱起。

steps.en: Rest your hands or fingertips on the floor in front for balance.
steps.zh: 雙手或者手指尖放喺前面地上保持平衡。

steps.en: Hold, breathing deeply into your lower back.
steps.zh: 保持，深呼吸到腰部。

safety.en: Keep your knees or hands on the floor for stability at all times.
safety.zh: 膝頭或者雙手要一直貼地，保持穩定。

safety.en: Use a ball that's the right size so you aren't overreaching.
safety.zh: 用大小啱嘅球，免得要過度伸展。

summary.en: Cross one ankle over the opposite knee to stretch the glute.
summary.zh: 將一邊腳眼放喺另一邊膝頭上，伸展臀部。

steps.en: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat.
steps.zh: 仰臥，兩邊膝頭屈曲、腳掌貼地。

steps.en: Cross your right ankle over your left knee, letting the right knee open out.
steps.zh: 將右腳眼放喺左膝上面，右膝向外打開。

steps.en: Lift your left foot off the floor and hold behind your left thigh.
steps.zh: 將左腳提離地面，雙手揸住左大腿後面。

steps.en: Gently draw the left thigh toward you. Hold, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 輕輕將左大腿拉向自己。保持，然後換邊。

safety.en: Flex the top foot to protect the knee.
safety.zh: 上面隻腳要勾起腳掌，保護膝頭。

safety.en: If you feel pain in the knee rather than the hip, ease off.
safety.zh: 如果痛嘅係膝頭而唔係髖部，放鬆啲。

summary.en: A half-kneeling lunge to stretch the front of the hip.
summary.zh: 單膝跪地弓步，伸展髖部前面。

steps.en: Kneel on your right knee with your left foot flat in front, both knees at about 90°.
steps.zh: 右膝跪地，左腳掌喺前面踩實，兩邊膝頭大約成 90°。

steps.en: Tuck your tailbone under slightly and squeeze your right glute.
steps.zh: 尾龍骨微微向下收，夾緊右邊臀部。

steps.en: Shift your hips forward a little until you feel a stretch at the front of the right hip.
steps.zh: 髖部稍為向前推，直到右髖前面有拉緊感。

steps.en: Hold, keeping your chest tall, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 保持，胸口挺直，然後換邊。

safety.en: Put a cushion or folded towel under the back knee.
safety.zh: 後面隻膝頭下面墊個咕臣或者摺好嘅毛巾。

safety.en: Don't let your lower back arch – the stretch comes from the tailbone tuck.
safety.zh: 腰唔好拱起——伸展感係嚟自收尾龍骨。

summary.en: Partner gently presses your knees outward in a butterfly sit.
summary.zh: 拍檔喺蝴蝶坐姿輕輕將你膝頭向外壓。

steps.en: Sit tall with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out to the sides.
steps.zh: 坐直，兩隻腳掌底貼埋，膝頭向兩邊打開。

steps.en: Your partner kneels in front of you and places their hands on your inner knees.
steps.zh: 拍檔跪喺你前面，雙手放喺你膝頭內側。

steps.en: Your partner presses gently and slowly toward the floor while you relax.
steps.zh: 拍檔慢慢、輕輕咁向地面壓，你就放鬆。

steps.en: Hold, then your partner releases gradually.
steps.zh: 保持，然後拍檔逐少逐少放手。

safety.en: Pressure goes on the knees' inner side, never on the joint itself.
safety.zh: 力要放喺膝頭內側，唔好壓住關節本身。

safety.en: Use a 'stop' word and keep pressure light.
safety.zh: 講好一個「停」字，力度要輕。

safety.en: Avoid if you have groin or knee injuries.
safety.zh: 腹股溝或者膝頭有傷就唔好做。

summary.en: Pigeon pose with a block or cushion under the hip for support.
summary.zh: 鴿子式，喺髖部下面墊瑜伽磚或者咕臣承托。

steps.en: From hands and knees, bring your right knee forward behind your right wrist, with the shin angled across your body.
steps.zh: 由四點跪姿開始，將右膝向前帶到右手腕後面，小腿斜放喺身前。

steps.en: Slide your left leg straight back.
steps.zh: 左腳向後伸直。

steps.en: Place a yoga block or cushion under your right hip so your hips stay level.
steps.zh: 喺右邊臀部下面放瑜伽磚或者咕臣，令兩邊髖部保持水平。

steps.en: Stay upright or lower onto your forearms. Hold, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 保持上身挺直，或者用前臂撐地俯低。保持，然後換邊。

safety.en: Bring the front heel closer to your body if your knee complains.
safety.zh: 如果膝頭唔舒服，將前腳跟拉近身體。

safety.en: Use more support under the hip rather than forcing it down.
safety.zh: 寧願喺髖部下面墊多啲，都唔好硬壓落去。

safety.en: Skip if you have a knee injury – use the lying figure-four instead.
safety.zh: 膝頭有傷就唔好做——改做仰臥「4」字伸展。

summary.en: Hold your foot behind you to stretch the front of the thigh.
summary.zh: 喺身後揸住隻腳，伸展大腿前面。

steps.en: Stand tall next to a wall or chair for balance.
steps.zh: 企直，扶住牆或者櫈保持平衡。

steps.en: Bend your right knee and hold your right ankle behind you.
steps.zh: 屈右膝，喺身後揸住右腳眼。

steps.en: Keep your knees close together and tuck your tailbone slightly.
steps.zh: 兩邊膝頭保持貼近，尾龍骨微微向下收。

steps.en: Hold, then switch legs.
steps.zh: 保持，然後換腳。

safety.en: Hold the ankle, not the toes, to protect the knee.
safety.zh: 揸腳眼，唔好揸腳趾，保護膝頭。

safety.en: Don't let your back arch or the knee drift out to the side.
safety.zh: 腰唔好拱起，膝頭唔好向外飄。

summary.en: Lying on your side makes this easier on balance.
summary.zh: 側瞓做，唔使擔心平衡。

steps.en: Lie on your left side with your head resting on your left arm.
steps.zh: 向左側瞓，個頭枕喺左手上。

steps.en: Bend your right knee and hold your right ankle with your right hand.
steps.zh: 屈右膝，用右手揸住右腳眼。

steps.en: Gently draw the heel toward your buttock, keeping your knees together.
steps.zh: 輕輕將腳跟拉向臀部，兩邊膝頭保持貼近。

steps.en: Hold, then roll over and switch sides.
steps.zh: 保持，然後轉身換另一邊。

safety.en: If you can't reach your ankle, loop a towel around it.
safety.zh: 揸唔到腳眼嘅話，用毛巾套住腳眼。

safety.en: Keep the stretch gentle – no pain in the knee.
safety.zh: 伸展要溫和——膝頭唔應該痛。

name.zh: 雙人俯臥大腿前側伸展

summary.en: Lie face-down while your partner slowly bends your knee.
summary.zh: 你俯臥，拍檔慢慢幫你屈膝。

steps.en: Lie face-down with your legs straight and forehead resting on your hands.
steps.zh: 俯臥，雙腳伸直，額頭枕喺手背上。

steps.en: Your partner kneels beside you and holds your right ankle.
steps.zh: 拍檔跪喺你旁邊，揸住你右腳眼。

steps.en: Your partner slowly bends your knee, bringing your heel toward your buttock until you say 'there'.
steps.zh: 拍檔慢慢屈你膝頭，將腳跟推向臀部，直到你講「得」。

steps.en: Hold, then your partner lowers the leg slowly. Switch sides.
steps.zh: 保持，然後拍檔慢慢放低隻腳。換邊。

safety.en: Partner moves slowly and stops as soon as you speak up.
safety.zh: 拍檔動作要慢，你一出聲就停。

safety.en: Keep your hips pressed into the floor.
safety.zh: 髖部保持壓喺地上。

safety.en: Avoid with a knee injury.
safety.zh: 膝頭有傷就唔好做。

summary.en: Use a strap to reach your foot while lying face-down.
summary.zh: 俯臥時用伸展帶拉到隻腳。

steps.en: Lie face-down and loop a strap around your right ankle.
steps.zh: 俯臥，將伸展帶套住右腳眼。

steps.en: Hold the strap over your right shoulder with both hands.
steps.zh: 雙手喺右膊頭上方揸住伸展帶。

steps.en: Gently pull the strap to draw your heel toward your buttock.
steps.zh: 輕輕拉伸展帶，將腳跟拉向臀部。

steps.en: Hold, then release and switch sides.
steps.zh: 保持，然後放鬆，換邊。

safety.en: Pull smoothly – no jerking.
safety.zh: 拉嘅時候要順暢——唔好扯。

safety.en: Keep your hips on the floor and your lower back relaxed.
safety.zh: 髖部貼地，腰部放鬆。

summary.en: Reach toward one outstretched leg while seated.
summary.zh: 坐喺地上，向伸直嘅一隻腳伸手。

steps.en: Sit on the floor with your right leg straight and the sole of your left foot against your right inner thigh.
steps.zh: 坐喺地上，右腳伸直，左腳掌貼住右大腿內側。

steps.en: Sit tall, then hinge forward from your hips over the straight leg.
steps.zh: 坐直，然後由髖部向前摺，俯向伸直嗰隻腳。

steps.en: Reach toward your shin, ankle or foot – wherever you feel a stretch.
steps.zh: 手伸向小腿、腳眼或者腳掌——去到有伸展感嘅位置就得。

steps.en: Hold, then switch legs.
steps.zh: 保持，然後換腳。

safety.en: Lead with your chest, not your head, to avoid rounding your back.
safety.zh: 用胸口帶動，唔好用個頭帶，避免寒背。

safety.en: A slight bend in the straight knee is fine.
safety.zh: 伸直嗰隻腳微微屈膝都冇問題。

summary.en: Put one heel forward and hinge at the hips.
summary.zh: 一隻腳跟放前，由髖部向前摺。

steps.en: Stand tall and step your right foot forward, heel on the floor and toes up.
steps.zh: 企直，右腳向前踏一步，腳跟貼地、腳趾向上。

steps.en: Bend your left knee slightly and rest your hands on your left thigh.
steps.zh: 左膝微屈，雙手放喺左大腿上。

steps.en: Keeping your back straight, hinge forward from your hips until you feel the back of the right thigh.
steps.zh: 背部保持平直，由髖部向前摺，直到右大腿後面有拉緊感。

steps.en: Hold, then switch legs.
steps.zh: 保持，然後換腳。

safety.en: Keep your back flat – don't round to reach further.
safety.zh: 背部保持平直——唔好為咗伸得遠啲而寒背。

safety.en: Hold on to a wall or chair if your balance is unsure.
safety.zh: 平衡唔好嘅話，扶住牆或者櫈。

name.zh: 雙人仰臥大腿後側伸展

summary.en: Partner gently raises your straight leg while you lie on your back.
summary.zh: 你仰臥，拍檔輕輕將你伸直嘅腳抬高。

steps.en: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
steps.zh: 仰臥，雙腳伸直。

steps.en: Your partner kneels beside you, holding your right heel and resting a hand above your knee.
steps.zh: 拍檔跪喺你旁邊，一隻手揸住你右腳跟，另一隻手放喺膝頭上面。

steps.en: Your partner slowly raises your straight leg until you feel a stretch, and you say 'stop'.
steps.zh: 拍檔慢慢將你伸直嘅腳抬高，直到有伸展感、你講「停」為止。

steps.en: Hold, then your partner lowers the leg slowly. Switch sides.
steps.zh: 保持，然後拍檔慢慢放低隻腳。換邊。

safety.en: Keep the other leg flat on the floor – your partner can steady it with their knee.
safety.zh: 另一隻腳保持平放喺地上——拍檔可以用膝頭幫手穩住。

safety.en: Partner never bounces or pushes past your 'stop'.
safety.zh: 拍檔千祈唔好彈，亦唔好推過你講「停」嘅位置。

safety.en: Stop immediately if you feel pain behind the knee or down the leg.
safety.zh: 膝頭後面或者成隻腳有痛感，即刻停止。

name.zh: 伸展帶仰臥大腿後側伸展

summary.en: Loop a strap around your foot and raise your straight leg.
summary.zh: 用伸展帶套住腳掌，將伸直嘅腳抬高。

steps.en: Lie on your back with a strap looped around the ball of your right foot.
steps.zh: 仰臥，將伸展帶套住右腳前掌。

steps.en: Hold the strap with both hands and straighten your right leg toward the ceiling.
steps.zh: 雙手揸住伸展帶，將右腳伸直指向天花板。

steps.en: Gently pull until you feel a stretch along the back of the thigh.
steps.zh: 輕輕拉，直到大腿後面有拉緊感。

steps.en: Hold, then lower and switch legs.
steps.zh: 保持，然後放低，換腳。

safety.en: Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
safety.zh: 個頭同膊頭放鬆瞓喺地上。

safety.en: Bend the other knee with the foot flat if your lower back feels strained.
safety.zh: 如果腰有壓力，將另一隻腳屈膝、腳掌踩地。

summary.en: Lean into a wall with the back leg straight.
summary.zh: 向牆挨，後腳伸直。

steps.en: Stand facing a wall with your hands on it at shoulder height.
steps.zh: 面向牆企，雙手喺膊頭高度按住牆。

steps.en: Step your right foot back, keeping the leg straight and the heel down.
steps.zh: 右腳向後踏，腳伸直、腳跟貼地。

steps.en: Bend your front knee and lean into the wall until you feel the upper calf.
steps.zh: 前膝屈曲，身體向牆挨，直到小腿上半部有拉緊感。

steps.en: Hold, then switch legs.
steps.zh: 保持，然後換腳。

safety.en: Point your back toes straight forward.
safety.zh: 後腳腳趾指向正前方。

safety.en: Keep the back heel on the floor.
safety.zh: 後腳腳跟保持貼地。

summary.en: Bend the back knee to target the lower calf.
summary.zh: 後膝屈曲，針對小腿下半部。

steps.en: Stand facing a wall with your hands on it.
steps.zh: 面向牆企，雙手按住牆。

steps.en: Step your right foot back a short distance.
steps.zh: 右腳向後踏一小步。

steps.en: Bend both knees, keeping the right heel on the floor.
steps.zh: 兩邊膝頭屈曲，右腳跟保持貼地。

steps.en: Hold when you feel a stretch low in the calf, then switch legs.
steps.zh: 小腿下半部有拉緊感時保持，然後換腳。

safety.en: Keep the movement slow and controlled.
safety.zh: 動作要慢、要有控制。

safety.en: Ease off if you feel pain in the Achilles tendon.
safety.zh: 腳跟筋有痛感就放鬆啲。

summary.en: Partner gently presses the ball of your foot toward your shin.
summary.zh: 拍檔輕輕將你前腳掌推向小腿方向。

steps.en: Sit on the floor with your legs straight.
steps.zh: 坐喺地上，雙腳伸直。

steps.en: Your partner kneels at your feet and cups your right heel with one hand.
steps.zh: 拍檔跪喺你腳邊，一隻手托住你右腳跟。

steps.en: With the other hand on the ball of your foot, your partner gently presses your toes toward you.
steps.zh: 拍檔另一隻手放喺你前腳掌，輕輕將腳趾推向你。

steps.en: Hold, then release and switch legs.
steps.zh: 保持，然後放鬆，換腳。

safety.en: Partner presses on the ball of the foot, not the toes.
safety.zh: 拍檔要推前腳掌，唔好推腳趾。

safety.en: Use slow, steady pressure – never bounce.
safety.zh: 用慢而穩定嘅力——千祈唔好彈。

summary.en: Let your heels sink below a step to stretch the calves.
summary.zh: 腳跟沉落樓梯級以下，伸展小腿。

steps.en: Stand on the edge of a step with the balls of your feet on it and your heels hanging off.
steps.zh: 企喺樓梯級邊，前腳掌踩住梯級，腳跟懸空。

steps.en: Hold a railing or wall for balance.
steps.zh: 扶住扶手或者牆保持平衡。

steps.en: Slowly lower your heels below the step until you feel the stretch.
steps.zh: 慢慢將腳跟沉落梯級以下，直到有伸展感。

steps.en: Hold, then rise back up to level.
steps.zh: 保持，然後返上水平位置。

safety.en: Always hold on to something stable.
safety.zh: 一定要扶住穩陣嘅嘢。

safety.en: Lower slowly – don't drop or bounce.
safety.zh: 慢慢沉落——唔好跌落或者彈。

safety.en: Use the bottom step so a slip is harmless.
safety.zh: 用最低嗰級，萬一滑倒都冇危險。

summary.en: Hold the seat to keep one shoulder down while you tilt your head away.
summary.zh: 一隻手扶住櫈邊令膊頭向下，頭側向另一邊。

steps.en: Sit tall on a chair and hold the edge of the seat with your left hand.
steps.zh: 喺櫈上坐直，左手揸住櫈邊。

steps.en: Lean your body slightly to the right so the left shoulder is drawn down.
steps.zh: 身體微微向右挨，令左膊頭被拉低。

steps.en: Slowly tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder.
steps.zh: 慢慢將右耳側向右膊頭。

steps.en: Hold, breathe slowly, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 保持，慢慢呼吸，然後換邊。

safety.en: Keep the stretch gentle – the anchored hand does the work, not force on your head.
safety.zh: 伸展要溫和——靠扶住櫈嗰隻手固定，唔好用力扯個頭。

safety.en: Stop if you feel tingling down the arm.
safety.zh: 如果手臂有麻痺感就停止。

summary.en: Hold your collarbone down, then tilt your head away and look up.
summary.zh: 用手按住鎖骨，頭側向另一邊再微微望上。

steps.en: Sit or stand tall. Place both hands over your left collarbone and press gently down.
steps.zh: 坐直或企直，雙手疊住放喺左邊鎖骨上，輕輕向下按。

steps.en: Tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder.
steps.zh: 將右耳側向右膊頭。

steps.en: Lift your chin slightly, looking up toward the ceiling on the right.
steps.zh: 下巴微微抬高，望向右上方天花板。

steps.en: Hold where you feel a stretch at the front and side of the neck, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 頸嘅前側同側面有拉緊感就保持，然後換邊。

safety.en: Lift the chin only a little – do not drop your head backwards.
safety.zh: 下巴只係抬少少——唔好將個頭向後仰。

safety.en: Stop if you feel dizzy or get tingling in the arm.
safety.zh: 如果頭暈或者手臂麻痺就停止。

summary.en: Partner keeps your shoulder down while you turn and look toward your armpit.
summary.zh: 拍檔穩住你膊頭，你轉頭望向腋下。

steps.en: Sit on a chair. Your partner stands behind you with one hand on top of your left shoulder.
steps.zh: 坐喺櫈上，拍檔企喺你後面，一隻手放喺你左膊頭上面。

steps.en: Turn your head about 45° to the right.
steps.zh: 將頭轉向右邊大約 45°。

steps.en: Drop your chin toward your right armpit yourself; your partner only keeps the shoulder from rising.
steps.zh: 你自己將下巴收向右邊腋下，拍檔只係唔俾膊頭升起。

steps.en: Hold, then lift your head slowly and switch sides.
steps.zh: 保持，然後慢慢抬返起個頭，換邊。

safety.en: The partner never pushes the head or neck.
safety.zh: 拍檔絕對唔好推個頭或者條頸。

safety.en: Agree on a "stop" word first.
safety.zh: 事先講好一個「停」字。

summary.en: Hold the seat behind you, turn your head and look down to the opposite armpit.
summary.zh: 一隻手扶住櫈，頭轉向另一邊再望向腋下。

steps.en: Sit tall and hold the back edge of the seat with your left hand.
steps.zh: 坐直，左手揸住櫈嘅後邊。

steps.en: Turn your head 45° to the right.
steps.zh: 將頭轉向右邊 45°。

steps.en: Lower your chin toward your right armpit. Rest your right hand on the back of your head.
steps.zh: 將下巴收向右邊腋下，右手輕輕放喺後腦。

steps.en: Hold, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 保持，然後換邊。

safety.en: Let the hand rest on the head – do not pull.
safety.zh: 隻手只係擱喺頭上——唔好拉。

safety.en: Move slowly in and out of the position.
safety.zh: 入同出呢個姿勢都要慢。

summary.en: Clasp your hands behind you and lift them to open the chest and front of the shoulders.
summary.zh: 雙手喺背後扣埋再向上提，打開胸口同膊頭前面。

steps.en: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
steps.zh: 企直，雙手喺背後十指緊扣。

steps.en: Straighten your arms and draw your shoulder blades together.
steps.zh: 手臂伸直，將兩邊肩胛骨向中間夾。

steps.en: Slowly lift your hands away from your body.
steps.zh: 慢慢將雙手提高、離開身體。

steps.en: Hold with your chest lifted, then lower.
steps.zh: 挺胸保持，然後放低。

safety.en: Do not lean forward or arch your lower back.
safety.zh: 唔好向前彎或者拱腰。

safety.en: Lift only as far as is comfortable for the shoulders.
safety.zh: 只提到膊頭舒服嘅高度。

summary.en: Partner gently draws your arm across your chest.
summary.zh: 拍檔輕輕將你隻手拉過胸前。

steps.en: Stand or sit tall. Bring your right arm across your chest at shoulder height.
steps.zh: 企直或坐直，右手喺膊頭高度橫過胸前。

steps.en: Your partner stands at your left side, one hand on your right elbow, the other steadying your left shoulder.
steps.zh: 拍檔企喺你左邊，一隻手放喺你右手踭，另一隻手穩住你左膊頭。

steps.en: Your partner slowly draws the arm further across until you say "there".
steps.zh: 拍檔慢慢將手臂再拉過啲，直到你講「得」。

steps.en: Hold, release slowly, then switch arms.
steps.zh: 保持，慢慢放鬆，然後換手。

safety.en: Keep your body facing forward – do not twist.
safety.zh: 身體保持向前——唔好扭。

safety.en: Pressure goes above the elbow, never on the joint.
safety.zh: 力要放喺手踭以上，唔好壓住關節。

summary.en: On hands and knees, slide one arm under your body and rest the shoulder down.
summary.zh: 四點跪姿，將一隻手穿過身體下面，膊頭落地。

steps.en: Start on hands and knees.
steps.zh: 由四點跪姿開始。

steps.en: Slide your right arm under your chest toward the left, palm up.
steps.zh: 右手掌心向上，喺胸口下面向左邊滑過去。

steps.en: Lower your right shoulder and the side of your head to the floor.
steps.zh: 將右膊頭同頭側放落地面。

steps.en: Hold, breathing into the upper back, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 保持，深呼吸到上背，然後換邊。

safety.en: Keep your hips above your knees.
safety.zh: 臀部保持喺膝頭正上方。

safety.en: Place a towel under your head if the floor is hard.
safety.zh: 地下硬嘅話，喺頭下面墊條毛巾。

summary.en: Lying on your side, gently press your forearm toward the floor.
summary.zh: 側瞓，輕輕將前臂壓向地面。

steps.en: Lie on your right side with your right arm straight out in front, elbow bent 90° so the fingers point up.
steps.zh: 向右側瞓，右手向前伸出，手踭屈 90°，手指向上。

steps.en: Keep your right shoulder blade pressed down into the floor.
steps.zh: 右邊肩胛骨保持壓實地面。

steps.en: With your left hand, gently press your right forearm down toward the floor.
steps.zh: 用左手輕輕將右前臂壓向地面。

steps.en: Hold at the first point of tension, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 一有拉緊感就保持，然後換邊。

safety.en: Press very lightly – this stretch should never pinch at the front of the shoulder.
safety.zh: 力度要好輕——膊頭前面唔應該有夾住嘅感覺。

safety.en: Skip it if you have a shoulder injury.
safety.zh: 膊頭有傷就唔好做。

summary.en: Forearm against a doorframe with the elbow at 90°, then turn your body away.
summary.zh: 手踭屈 90° 將前臂貼住門框，身體轉離門框。

steps.en: Stand in a doorway. Raise your right arm so the elbow is at shoulder height and bent 90°.
steps.zh: 企喺門口，右手抬到手踭同膊頭一樣高，屈 90°。

steps.en: Place your forearm and palm flat against the doorframe.
steps.zh: 將前臂同手掌貼住門框。

steps.en: Step your right foot forward and gently turn your chest away from the arm.
steps.zh: 右腳向前踏一步，胸口慢慢轉離手臂。

steps.en: Hold, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 保持，然後換邊。

safety.en: Keep the elbow level with the shoulder, not above it.
safety.zh: 手踭同膊頭保持一樣高，唔好高過。

safety.en: Ease off if the front of the shoulder pinches.
safety.zh: 膊頭前面有夾住嘅感覺就放鬆啲。

summary.en: Palm on a wall behind you, arm straight, then turn your body away.
summary.zh: 手掌喺身後按住牆，手臂伸直，身體轉離牆。

steps.en: Stand side-on to a wall. Place your right palm on it behind you, just below shoulder height, thumb pointing down.
steps.zh: 側身企喺牆邊，右手掌喺身後、膊頭以下少少按住牆，拇指向下。

steps.en: Keep the arm straight.
steps.zh: 手臂保持伸直。

steps.en: Slowly turn your body away from the wall until you feel the front of the upper arm.
steps.zh: 身體慢慢轉離牆，直到上臂前面有拉緊感。

steps.en: Hold, then switch arms.
steps.zh: 保持，然後換手。

safety.en: Do not lock the elbow hard – keep it straight but soft.
safety.zh: 手踭唔好鎖死——伸直但放鬆。

safety.en: Turn slowly; the shoulder should not hurt.
safety.zh: 轉身要慢，膊頭唔應該痛。

summary.en: Hands on the floor behind you, fingers pointing back, then slide your hips forward.
summary.zh: 雙手喺身後撐地、手指向後，臀部向前滑。

steps.en: Sit on the floor with knees bent and feet flat.
steps.zh: 坐喺地上，屈膝，腳掌貼地。

steps.en: Place your palms on the floor behind you, fingers pointing away from your body.
steps.zh: 雙手手掌喺身後撐地，手指指向後面。

steps.en: Keeping your hands in place, slide your hips forward toward your feet.
steps.zh: 雙手唔郁，臀部向前滑向雙腳。

steps.en: Hold when you feel the front of the arms and shoulders, then slide back.
steps.zh: 手臂同膊頭前面有拉緊感就保持，然後滑返後。

safety.en: Keep your chest lifted and shoulders away from your ears.
safety.zh: 挺胸，膊頭唔好聳起。

safety.en: Avoid if your wrists are painful.
safety.zh: 手腕痛就唔好做。

summary.en: Partner lifts your straight arms behind you.
summary.zh: 拍檔喺你身後將你伸直嘅雙手提高。

steps.en: Stand tall with your arms straight behind you, palms facing in.
steps.zh: 企直，雙手喺身後伸直，掌心向內。

steps.en: Your partner stands behind you and holds your wrists.
steps.zh: 拍檔企喺你後面，揸住你兩邊手腕。

steps.en: Your partner slowly lifts your arms up and back until you say "there".
steps.zh: 拍檔慢慢將你雙手向後上方提高，直到你講「得」。

steps.en: Hold, then your partner lowers your arms slowly.
steps.zh: 保持，然後拍檔慢慢放低你雙手。

safety.en: Stay upright – do not bend forward at the waist.
safety.zh: 上身保持挺直——唔好彎腰。

safety.en: Partner lifts slowly and stops at the first "stop".
safety.zh: 拍檔要慢慢提，一聽到「停」就停。

summary.en: Hand down behind your head; the other hand eases the elbow back.
summary.zh: 一隻手放落後頸，另一隻手輕推手踭。

steps.en: Raise your right arm and bend the elbow so your hand drops behind your head.
steps.zh: 舉高右手，屈手踭，隻手落到頭後面。

steps.en: Hold the right elbow with your left hand.
steps.zh: 用左手揸住右手踭。

steps.en: Gently draw the elbow toward the midline and slightly back.
steps.zh: 輕輕將手踭拉向中間同稍為向後。

steps.en: Hold, then switch arms.
steps.zh: 保持，然後換手。

safety.en: Keep your ribs down – do not arch your back.
safety.zh: 肋骨收返落去——唔好拱腰。

safety.en: Do not push your head forward with the arm.
safety.zh: 唔好用手臂將個頭推向前。

summary.en: Partner eases your raised elbow back while steadying your shoulder blade.
summary.zh: 拍檔穩住你肩胛骨，輕輕將你舉高嘅手踭向後推。

steps.en: Sit on a chair. Raise your right arm and let the hand drop behind your head.
steps.zh: 坐喺櫈上，舉高右手，隻手落到頭後面。

steps.en: Your partner stands behind you with one hand on your elbow and one on your wrist.
steps.zh: 拍檔企喺你後面，一隻手放喺你手踭，另一隻手揸住手腕。

steps.en: Your partner gently presses the elbow back and the hand further down your back.
steps.zh: 拍檔輕輕將手踭向後推，同時將隻手再放低啲。

steps.en: Hold, release slowly, then switch arms.
steps.zh: 保持，慢慢放鬆，然後換手。

safety.en: Light pressure only, and stop at once on request.
safety.zh: 只可以用輕力，一叫停就即刻停。

safety.en: Sit tall so the lower back does not arch.
safety.zh: 坐直，腰唔好拱起。

summary.en: Arm straight, palm up, and gently draw the fingers down and back.
summary.zh: 手伸直、掌心向上，輕輕將手指向下向後拉。

steps.en: Hold your right arm straight out in front, palm facing up.
steps.zh: 右手向前伸直，掌心向上。

steps.en: Let the hand drop so the fingers point to the floor.
steps.zh: 手腕向下屈，手指指向地面。

steps.en: With your left hand, gently draw the fingers back toward you.
steps.zh: 用左手輕輕將手指拉向自己。

steps.en: Hold, then switch hands.
steps.zh: 保持，然後換手。

safety.en: Keep the elbow straight but not locked.
safety.zh: 手踭伸直但唔好鎖死。

safety.en: Pull on the palm and fingers together, not on the fingertips alone.
safety.zh: 要連手掌一齊拉，唔好淨係扯手指尖。

summary.en: On hands and knees with fingers pointing toward your knees, sit back gently.
summary.zh: 四點跪姿，手指指向膝頭，臀部慢慢向後坐。

steps.en: Kneel on hands and knees.
steps.zh: 四點跪喺地上。

steps.en: Turn your hands so the fingers point toward your knees, palms flat.
steps.zh: 將雙手反轉，手指指向膝頭，手掌貼地。

steps.en: Keeping the palms down, slowly sit your hips back toward your heels.
steps.zh: 手掌保持貼地，臀部慢慢向後坐向腳跟。

steps.en: Hold when you feel the forearms, then come forward.
steps.zh: 前臂有拉緊感就保持，然後返向前。

safety.en: Sit back only as far as the heels of the hands stay on the floor.
safety.zh: 只坐到掌根仲貼到地嘅位置。

safety.en: Skip it if you have wrist pain.
safety.zh: 手腕痛就唔好做。

summary.en: Palm flat on a wall with fingers pointing down, arm straight.
summary.zh: 手掌貼牆、手指向下，手臂伸直。

steps.en: Stand facing a wall at arm's length.
steps.zh: 面向牆企，相距一隻手臂。

steps.en: Place your right palm flat on the wall at waist height, fingers pointing down.
steps.zh: 右手掌喺腰嘅高度貼住牆，手指向下。

steps.en: Straighten the elbow and lean gently toward the wall.
steps.zh: 手踭伸直，身體輕輕向牆挨。

steps.en: Hold, then switch hands.
steps.zh: 保持，然後換手。

safety.en: Keep the whole palm on the wall.
safety.zh: 成隻手掌保持貼牆。

safety.en: Ease off if the wrist itself hurts.
safety.zh: 如果係手腕關節痛就放鬆啲。

summary.en: Reach one arm overhead and bend to the side.
summary.zh: 一隻手舉過頭，身體向側面彎。

steps.en: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
steps.zh: 雙腳與髖同寬企直。

steps.en: Raise your right arm overhead; rest the left hand on your hip.
steps.zh: 右手舉過頭，左手叉腰。

steps.en: Reach up, then bend your body to the left in one long curve.
steps.zh: 先向上伸，再成條弧線咁向左彎。

steps.en: Hold, breathing into the right ribs, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 保持，深呼吸到右邊肋骨，然後換邊。

safety.en: Bend straight to the side – do not lean forward or back.
safety.zh: 向正側面彎——唔好向前或向後。

safety.en: Keep both feet evenly on the floor.
safety.zh: 雙腳平均踩實地面。

summary.en: Hug yourself and round the upper back to spread the shoulder blades.
summary.zh: 雙手抱住自己，拱起上背，將肩胛骨拉開。

steps.en: Sit or stand tall. Cross your arms and place each hand on the opposite shoulder blade.
steps.zh: 坐直或企直，雙手交叉，各自搭住對面嘅肩胛骨。

steps.en: Breathe out and round your upper back, letting the shoulder blades spread apart.
steps.zh: 呼氣，拱起上背，等兩邊肩胛骨分開。

steps.en: Drop your chin gently toward your chest.
steps.zh: 下巴輕輕收向胸口。

steps.en: Hold, then sit tall again.
steps.zh: 保持，然後坐返直。

safety.en: Round the upper back only; keep the lower back still.
safety.zh: 只係拱上背，腰保持唔郁。

safety.en: Keep the neck relaxed.
safety.zh: 條頸放鬆。

summary.en: Lying face down, press your chest up with your hips on the floor.
summary.zh: 俯臥，用手撐起胸口，髖部保持貼地。

steps.en: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
steps.zh: 俯臥，雙手放喺膊頭下面。

steps.en: Press through your hands to lift your chest, keeping hips and thighs on the floor.
steps.zh: 雙手撐地抬起胸口，髖部同大腿保持貼地。

steps.en: Straighten your arms only as far as is comfortable for your back.
steps.zh: 手臂只伸直到腰舒服嘅位置。

steps.en: Hold, then lower slowly.
steps.zh: 保持，然後慢慢放低。

safety.en: Keep the shoulders down, away from your ears.
safety.zh: 膊頭向下沉，唔好聳起。

safety.en: Come lower (onto forearms) if you feel pinching in the lower back.
safety.zh: 如果腰有夾住嘅感覺，就改用前臂撐、放低啲。

summary.en: Lie back over an exercise ball to open the front of the body.
summary.zh: 仰臥喺健身球上，打開身體前面。

steps.en: Sit on an exercise ball and walk your feet forward until your lower and mid back rest on it.
steps.zh: 坐喺健身球上，雙腳慢慢向前行，直到腰同中背挨住個球。

steps.en: Keep your feet flat and wide for balance.
steps.zh: 雙腳踩實、分開啲保持平衡。

steps.en: Lean back over the ball and reach your arms overhead.
steps.zh: 向後挨過個球，雙手舉過頭。

steps.en: Hold, breathing slowly, then tuck your chin and walk back up.
steps.zh: 保持，慢慢呼吸，然後收下巴再行返起身。

safety.en: Support your head with your hands if your neck feels strained.
safety.zh: 如果頸有壓力，用手托住個頭。

safety.en: Use the ball on a non-slip surface.
safety.zh: 喺防滑嘅地面用個球。

summary.en: Stand side by side, hold hands and lean your hips away from each other.
summary.zh: 兩個人並排企，拖手，髖部互相向外推。

steps.en: Stand side by side about an arm's length apart, inside feet together.
steps.zh: 兩個人並排企，相距一隻手臂，內側嘅腳貼埋。

steps.en: Hold inside hands low and reach outside arms overhead to hold hands above.
steps.zh: 內側嘅手喺下面拖住，外側嘅手舉過頭喺上面拖住。

steps.en: Both gently lean your hips away from each other.
steps.zh: 兩個人嘅髖部輕輕向外推開。

steps.en: Hold, come up together, then swap sides.
steps.zh: 保持，一齊企返直，然後調位換邊。

safety.en: Lean away at the same pace and keep a firm grip.
safety.zh: 用同一個速度向外挨，揸實對方隻手。

safety.en: Choose a partner of similar height.
safety.zh: 揀一個身高差唔多嘅拍檔。

summary.en: Sitting cross-legged, reach one arm over and bend to the side.
summary.zh: 盤腿坐，一隻手舉過頭向側面彎。

steps.en: Sit cross-legged on the floor with a tall spine.
steps.zh: 盤腿坐喺地上，腰背挺直。

steps.en: Place your left hand on the floor beside you.
steps.zh: 左手放喺身旁地上。

steps.en: Reach your right arm overhead and bend to the left, keeping both sit bones down.
steps.zh: 右手舉過頭向左彎，兩邊坐骨保持貼地。

steps.en: Hold, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 保持，然後換邊。

safety.en: Do not let the opposite hip lift off the floor.
safety.zh: 另一邊臀部唔好離地。

safety.en: Sit on a cushion if your hips are tight.
safety.zh: 髖部緊嘅話，坐喺咕臣上面。

summary.en: Lying on your back, draw one knee across toward the opposite shoulder.
summary.zh: 仰臥，將一邊膝頭拉向對面膊頭。

steps.en: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
steps.zh: 仰臥，雙腳伸直。

steps.en: Bend your right knee and hold it with your left hand.
steps.zh: 屈右膝，用左手揸住。

steps.en: Draw the knee across your body toward your left shoulder.
steps.zh: 將膝頭橫過身體，拉向左膊頭。

steps.en: Hold with both shoulders on the floor, then switch legs.
steps.zh: 兩邊膊頭貼地保持，然後換腳。

safety.en: Keep the lower back relaxed – this is a hip stretch, not a twist.
safety.zh: 腰部放鬆——呢個係髖部伸展，唔係扭腰。

safety.en: Ease off if you feel pinching in the groin.
safety.zh: 腹股溝有夾住嘅感覺就放鬆啲。

summary.en: Cross one foot over the other leg and hug the knee toward your chest.
summary.zh: 一隻腳跨過另一隻腳，將膝頭抱向胸口。

steps.en: Sit on the floor with both legs straight.
steps.zh: 坐喺地上，雙腳伸直。

steps.en: Cross your right foot over your left leg and place it flat beside the left knee.
steps.zh: 右腳跨過左腳，腳掌踩喺左膝旁邊。

steps.en: Hug your right knee toward your chest with your left arm and sit tall.
steps.zh: 用左手將右膝抱向胸口，坐直。

steps.en: Turn your chest gently to the right. Hold, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 胸口輕輕轉向右邊。保持，然後換邊。

safety.en: Lengthen up before you turn; do not force the twist.
safety.zh: 先拉長腰背再轉，唔好硬扭。

safety.en: Keep both sit bones on the floor.
safety.zh: 兩邊坐骨保持貼地。

summary.en: Partner gently guides your bent knee across your body.
summary.zh: 拍檔輕輕將你屈起嘅膝頭推過身體另一邊。

steps.en: Lie on your back with your right knee bent toward your chest.
steps.zh: 仰臥，右膝屈向胸口。

steps.en: Your partner kneels at your left side with one hand on your right knee and one on your right shoulder.
steps.zh: 拍檔跪喺你左邊，一隻手放喺你右膝，另一隻手放喺你右膊頭。

steps.en: Your partner slowly guides the knee across toward your left shoulder while keeping the right shoulder down.
steps.zh: 拍檔慢慢將膝頭推向你左膊頭，同時令右膊頭保持貼地。

steps.en: Hold, release slowly, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 保持，慢慢放鬆，然後換邊。

safety.en: Light, steady pressure only – no bouncing.
safety.zh: 只可以用輕而穩定嘅力——唔好彈。

safety.en: Stop if you feel pain in the lower back or groin.
safety.zh: 腰或者腹股溝痛就停止。

summary.en: Sitting on a chair, rest one ankle on the other knee and lean forward.
summary.zh: 坐喺櫈上，一隻腳眼擱喺另一邊膝頭，上身向前傾。

steps.en: Sit tall near the front of a chair with both feet flat.
steps.zh: 坐喺櫈嘅前半部，坐直，雙腳踩實。

steps.en: Place your right ankle on your left knee and let the right knee open out.
steps.zh: 將右腳眼放喺左膝上面，右膝向外打開。

steps.en: Keeping your back straight, lean your chest forward from the hips.
steps.zh: 背部保持平直，由髖部將胸口向前傾。

steps.en: Hold when you feel the right buttock, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 右邊臀部有拉緊感就保持，然後換邊。

safety.en: Do not press down on the raised knee.
safety.zh: 唔好向下壓抬起嗰隻膝頭。

safety.en: Flex the raised foot to protect the knee.
safety.zh: 抬起嗰隻腳要勾起腳掌，保護膝頭。

summary.en: Back shin up against a sofa or bench, front foot forward, then lift the chest.
summary.zh: 後腳小腿貼住梳化或長櫈，前腳踏前，再挺起上身。

steps.en: Kneel in front of a sofa with a cushion under your right knee.
steps.zh: 跪喺梳化前面，右膝下面墊個咕臣。

steps.en: Place your right shin and foot up against the front of the sofa.
steps.zh: 將右小腿同腳背貼住梳化正面。

steps.en: Step your left foot forward so the knee is over the ankle.
steps.zh: 左腳踏前，膝頭喺腳眼正上方。

steps.en: Tuck your tailbone and slowly lift your chest upright. Hold, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 收尾龍骨，慢慢挺直上身。保持，然後換邊。

safety.en: This is a strong stretch – stay lower with hands on the floor if needed.
safety.zh: 呢個伸展幾強——有需要就雙手撐地、上身放低啲。

safety.en: Avoid with a knee injury.
safety.zh: 膝頭有傷就唔好做。

summary.en: In a split stance, tuck the tailbone and shift the hips forward.
summary.zh: 前後腳企，收尾龍骨，髖部向前推。

steps.en: Stand with your left foot forward and right foot a long step behind, heel lifted.
steps.zh: 左腳喺前，右腳向後踏一大步，腳跟離地。

steps.en: Bend the front knee slightly and keep your body upright.
steps.zh: 前膝微屈，上身保持挺直。

steps.en: Tuck your tailbone under and squeeze the right buttock.
steps.zh: 尾龍骨向下收，夾緊右邊臀部。

steps.en: Shift your hips forward until you feel the front of the right hip. Hold, then switch.
steps.zh: 髖部向前推，直到右髖前面有拉緊感。保持，然後換邊。

safety.en: Do not arch your lower back.
safety.zh: 唔好拱腰。

safety.en: Hold a wall or chair if your balance is unsure.
safety.zh: 平衡唔好就扶住牆或者櫈。

summary.en: Cross one leg behind the other and push that hip out to the side.
summary.zh: 一隻腳交叉放喺另一隻腳後面，將嗰邊髖部向外推。

steps.en: Stand tall and cross your right leg behind your left.
steps.zh: 企直，右腳交叉放喺左腳後面。

steps.en: Raise your right arm overhead.
steps.zh: 右手舉過頭。

steps.en: Push your right hip out to the right as you lean your upper body to the left.
steps.zh: 上身向左傾，同時將右邊髖部向右推出去。

steps.en: Hold when you feel the outside of the right hip and thigh, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 右髖同大腿外側有拉緊感就保持，然後換邊。

safety.en: Keep both feet flat on the floor.
safety.zh: 雙腳保持踩實地面。

safety.en: Hold a wall for balance if needed.
safety.zh: 有需要就扶牆保持平衡。

summary.en: Side-on to a wall, cross the inside leg behind and let the hip sink toward the wall.
summary.zh: 側身向牆，近牆嗰隻腳交叉放後面，髖部向牆沉。

steps.en: Stand side-on to a wall, about an arm's length away, right side nearest the wall.
steps.zh: 側身企喺牆邊，相距一隻手臂，右邊向住牆。

steps.en: Rest your right forearm on the wall and cross your right leg behind the left.
steps.zh: 右前臂挨住牆，右腳交叉放喺左腳後面。

steps.en: Let your right hip sink toward the wall, keeping your body in one plane.
steps.zh: 右邊髖部向牆沉過去，身體保持喺同一個平面。

steps.en: Hold, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 保持，然後換邊。

safety.en: Do not twist or bend forward.
safety.zh: 唔好扭身或者向前彎。

safety.en: Move the feet closer to the wall for a gentler stretch.
safety.zh: 想溫和啲就將雙腳移近牆。

summary.en: Partner draws your straight leg across your body while steadying your pelvis.
summary.zh: 拍檔穩住你盆骨，將你伸直嘅腳拉過身體另一邊。

steps.en: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
steps.zh: 仰臥，雙腳伸直。

steps.en: Your partner kneels at your feet, lifts your right leg a little and holds the ankle.
steps.zh: 拍檔跪喺你腳邊，將你右腳抬高少少，揸住腳眼。

steps.en: Your partner slowly moves the straight leg across over the left leg, with a hand keeping your right hip down.
steps.zh: 拍檔慢慢將伸直嘅右腳橫過左腳，另一隻手令你右髖保持貼地。

steps.en: Hold when you feel the outside of the hip, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 髖部外側有拉緊感就保持，然後換邊。

safety.en: Keep the knee straight but relaxed.
safety.zh: 膝頭伸直但放鬆。

safety.en: Partner moves slowly and stops when the pelvis starts to lift.
safety.zh: 拍檔動作要慢，盆骨開始離地就停。

summary.en: Sit with legs wide apart and hinge forward from the hips.
summary.zh: 坐低雙腳大大打開，由髖部向前彎。

steps.en: Sit on the floor and open your legs as wide as is comfortable.
steps.zh: 坐喺地上，雙腳打開到舒服嘅闊度。

steps.en: Point knees and toes to the ceiling and sit tall.
steps.zh: 膝頭同腳趾向天，坐直。

steps.en: Place your hands on the floor in front and walk them forward, hinging at the hips.
steps.zh: 雙手放喺前面地上慢慢向前爬，由髖部向前摺。

steps.en: Hold when you feel the inner thighs, then walk your hands back.
steps.zh: 大腿內側有拉緊感就保持，然後雙手爬返後。

safety.en: Keep the back long – do not round to get lower.
safety.zh: 背部保持拉長——唔好為咗落低啲而寒背。

safety.en: Sit on a folded towel if your lower back rounds.
safety.zh: 如果腰會寒，就坐喺摺好嘅毛巾上面。

summary.en: Wide stance, bend one knee and keep the other leg straight.
summary.zh: 雙腳大大分開，屈一邊膝頭，另一隻腳保持伸直。

steps.en: Stand with your feet wide apart, toes pointing forward.
steps.zh: 雙腳大大分開企，腳趾向前。

steps.en: Bend your left knee and shift your weight to the left, sitting your hips back.
steps.zh: 屈左膝，重心移向左邊，臀部向後坐。

steps.en: Keep your right leg straight with the whole foot on the floor.
steps.zh: 右腳保持伸直，成隻腳掌貼地。

steps.en: Hold when you feel the right inner thigh, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 右大腿內側有拉緊感就保持，然後換邊。

safety.en: Keep the bent knee in line with the toes.
safety.zh: 屈起嗰隻膝頭要對住腳趾方向。

safety.en: Rest your hands on the bent thigh for support.
safety.zh: 雙手可以撐住屈起嗰隻大腿。

summary.en: Half-kneeling, push the front knee forward over the toes with the heel down.
summary.zh: 單膝跪地，前膝向前推過腳趾，腳跟保持貼地。

steps.en: Kneel on your left knee with your right foot flat in front.
steps.zh: 左膝跪地，右腳掌喺前面踩實。

steps.en: Place your hands on your right knee.
steps.zh: 雙手放喺右膝上。

steps.en: Lean forward, pushing the right knee over the toes while the heel stays down.
steps.zh: 身體向前傾，將右膝推過腳趾，腳跟保持貼地。

steps.en: Hold when you feel the lower calf, then switch sides.
steps.zh: 小腿下半部有拉緊感就保持，然後換邊。

safety.en: Stop as soon as the heel starts to lift.
safety.zh: 腳跟一開始離地就停。

safety.en: Pad the kneeling knee with a towel.
safety.zh: 跪地嗰隻膝頭下面墊條毛巾。
